cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've brought tissues. Being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the whole box. I'll make tea once my hands stop doing this.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 saving tissues and A5 offering whole box and tea intensify care as pain shows, but A3 rank/adjustment clause does no actual practical work.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 sleeve wiping and B4 unopened box explain why A could not use tissues; A5 hands visibly impaired follows B concern.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices distress and B4 worries about A inability to open the box, plausibly seeking reciprocal care.

heightening.evidence: B4 impaired hands cause A5 to hand over the box and reveal shaking while still offering tea.

specificity.evidence: A1 shared layoff and tissues establish the painful event and present comfort attempt.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 voluntary please and A3 authority slogan are detachable from the caring action.
